name: Red Runtz 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Red Pop x Runtz

Breeder: Exotic Genetix

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene

Effects: Blissful, Relaxed, Stress-Free

Aroma: Sweet, Citrusy, Dank

Red Runtz is a Red Pop x Runtz, selected by Pro Gro, with quick heady effects and a strong euphoria consumers are provided a baseline flavor of sweet, dank undertones that complement a relaxing and creative immersion. This strain fires up the imagination, possibly having you explore a bit more of your artistic side - Enjoy!
